# Importer brief

## Section 4. Rejects
Every rejected row is written to rejects.csv with its line number. Rejected rows MUST be reported, never dropped silently.

## Section 5. Partial loads
This section says nothing about what happens to a partially loaded file when a reject is found.

## Section 6. Files
The widest production file has forty columns. The benchmark file has twelve columns and 21600 rows.
